name: Cosplay Musume M Choukyou ~Otsukiai Shite Kureru Nara, Nandemo Shimasu...~
original_name: コスプレ娘M調教 ～お付き合いしてくれるなら、なんでもします……～
source:
Wataru is a hardcore sadist, because of this, his relationship has always been short-lived.
One day, Mei, his landlord's daughter and neighborhood, confesses to him.
Wataru feeling afraid of being hurt again confesses his sadistic nature to her.
"If you can keep up with me, I will date you" he says.
Mei agrees, to his surprise.​
translation:
渡是个彻头彻尾的施虐狂，因此他的恋爱关系总是很短暂。

某天，房东的女儿兼邻居少女芽衣向他告白。渡害怕再次受伤，于是向她坦白了自己的施虐倾向。

“如果你能跟上我，我就和你交往。”

令他惊讶的是，芽衣答应了。
